digest.component_or_area: Jira DC adapter transport pager and enrichment handlers
propositions: _paged_search loops indefinitely when the server ignores startAt offsets, re-serving the same page until a harness cap terminates it (measured: 26 calls instead of 2)
The pager's only loop exit is an empty-batch check, which never fires when the server repeats a non-empty page, so out grows unbounded
Fail-open exception handlers at get_parent_map and three fetch_snapshot enrichment sites silently convert pager-level stalls into degraded snapshots instead of re-raising
A startAt-honouring server MUST serve different issues per offset; any repeated page signals offset-stall and cannot false-positive on well-behaved servers
The fix adds BackendPaginationStallError to core (so fetcher can name it without layering inversion), raises it when any page repeats, and re-raises it past all four fail-open boundaries
